{{Quote|Help me. A droid is not supposed to dream. This mind is overwhelming.|AR-72|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''AR-72''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in the employ of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. AR-72 was designed to interface with the "brain" of the [[the Tomb]], a [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] complex on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]], so that he could bring the prison's communication systems online for the Empire. After forty-seven straight [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] of being connected to the brain, AR-72 was being overwhelmed by the Rakata technology, and was "dreaming" at times. AR-72 recruited the help of Imperial forces to retrieve the key for the command console, as the [[Esh-kha]] were guarding the key,<ref name="TOR" /> and later remotely recruited more Imperials to destroy the radiation-generating machines in the [[overrun machine vault]].<ref name="TOR2">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Deadly Mutations|[[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
AR-72 appears on Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where he provides Imperial players with the missions "Ancient Transmissions" and "Deadly Mutations."<ref name="TOR" />
